source.title: Experience League: Get started with GenStudio for Performance Marketing

product_facts: GenStudio for Performance Marketing is an application built on Adobe's generative AI platform. It lets your marketing teams create, manage and optimize campaign content for ads and email.
GenStudio for Performance Marketing creates and optimizes the campaign content for ads and email.

We would start with your brand guidelines, which the generative AI uses as guardrails that guide content generation, and with templates that contain approved features and are optimized for specific channels.

Activation takes an approved ad experience and its assets, applies the setup the channel requires and delivers it directly to a channel such as Meta or LinkedIn in an inactive status, for your final review in the channel's own ad manager.

Once a channel account is connected, Insights receives data from your active campaigns, media and ads and provides analytics on content performance. You can find content that is not performing well and create variations of it with the integrated generative AI.

Editors create campaign assets, request content review and approval and publish the approved drafts; collaborators view and approve content. With Workfront Proof, the review gains approval templates, multi-stage workflows and proof version comparison.

source.title: Experience League: Plan for a new Marketo Engage implementation

product_facts: There are two documented routes. The simpler one: forms built in Marketo Engage are embedded on the site's pages with Marketo's own embed code, so each submission is a Marketo form fill. We would place the embed in a reusable page component, agree the fields, consent wording and validation with you, and collect only the data you approve. Marketo's form prefill does not work with the embed code.

The fuller one: AEM Forms adaptive forms with the Submit to Marketo Engage action, which add a rule editor, prefill and a PDF record of each submission, and can connect to Adobe Sign for e-signatures. We would use embedded Marketo forms for standard lead capture and adaptive forms where a form needs that logic.
Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform, a single solution that lets you attract, segment and nurture your customers. Each marketing initiative runs as a program.
Marketo Engage runs the marketing programs that attract, segment and nurture your customers.

We would configure the admin settings, including CNAMEs and Marketo's JavaScript tracking code, Munchkin, which tracks the people who visit your website so that automated campaigns can react to their visits. We would test the automation workflows and the data sync before launch.
Campaigns run as Smart Campaigns. A Smart List defines who you want to target, using filters and triggers, and the flow sets the steps the campaign performs, including wait steps and split choices.

services.name: CRM sync and field mapping
services.scope: Agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.
services.adobe_quote: This tutorial walks you through how the sync works, setting up the sync to get the right data flowing

source.title: Experience League: Best practices for implementing Marketo Measure JavaScript

product_facts: Marketo Measure is a marketing attribution solution: it automatically tracks and reports on channel performance, showing which marketing efforts are the most effective in driving revenue, so you can optimize your marketing spend.
Marketo Measure attributes revenue credit to the marketing channels and touchpoints.

We would add the Marketo Measure JavaScript to all your web properties, where it tracks online marketing interactions, called touchpoints. The standard installation puts a Salesforce Package or a Microsoft Dynamics Managed Solution in your CRM, where the captured data is housed and organized.

Attribution assigns revenue credit to marketing touchpoints by tracking the whole journey, from a prospect's first interaction with your company to when the deal closes. Marketo Measure offers six types of attribution models, from simple single-touch models to more complex multi-touch models.

Its ROI Dashboard gives a granular view of returns on investment across channels, subchannels and campaigns. Spend data is key to that reporting, so we would make sure the appropriate spend data for each of your channels is pulled into Marketo Measure.

source.title: Experience League: Marketing Campaign Analytics administration

product_facts: Marketing Campaign Analytics measures your campaigns and optimizes planning holistically across all your channels. It provides the incremental impact of your marketing activities on business and campaign outcomes, for digital and offline marketing.
Marketing Campaign Analytics measures the incremental impact of your marketing across channels and plans the budget.

It works with event level data and with aggregate or summary data such as offline advertising. We would ingest that data, configure the mapping and conflict resolution rules that merge your marketing datasets, then build models that measure and predict the outcome you specify.

Its marketing mix modeling is a privacy-friendly machine learning analysis of the incremental impact of marketing tactics and business factors on conversion metrics. Transfer learning unifies it with multi-touch attribution, so measurement and planning give consistent results.
Plans allocate budgets by business unit and channel, using the outcomes of the trained models. You can develop multiple budget plans and compare their impact before you decide.
Access is controlled through Experience Platform, in the Adobe Admin Console and through Permissions.

product_facts: Marketo Qualifier is Adobe's app for business development representatives: its Account Qualification Agent analyzes your accounts and prospects, prioritizes those that are ready for the next step, and drafts personalized outreach based on your CRM data.
Marketo Qualifier prioritizes the accounts and prospects for your business development representatives and drafts their outreach.

Once Adobe provisions Marketo Qualifier, we would create the user groups and connect Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 with your CRM administrator, then map the inbound fields. The first connection needs read-only access; activity synchronization and opt-out write-back need write access.

In an Outbound Workflow your team defines the goal and targeting criteria; AI proposes a multitouch cadence and writes personalized email content for each prospect, using your sales materials in the Knowledge Center. No email is sent until the prospect's owner approves it.

Brand Concierge hands a conversation to a person through live chat or meeting booking, keeping the context the visitor already provided. Both route through Marketo Qualifier, where your representatives connect their calendars, set their availability and take chats; the first representative to accept takes it.

Marketo Qualifier reports on outbound activity and results across your team, and by Outbound Workflow campaign on active prospects, open rate, click rate, reply rate and meetings booked. With activity sync on, your representatives see the outreach activities in the CRM.

product_facts: Marketo Qualifier is Adobe's app for business development representatives: its Account Qualification Agent analyzes your accounts and prospects, prioritizes those that are ready for the next step, and drafts personalized outreach based on your CRM data.
Marketo Qualifier prioritizes the accounts and prospects for your business development representatives and drafts their outreach.

Once Adobe provisions Marketo Qualifier, we would create the user groups and connect Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 with your CRM administrator, then map the inbound fields. The first connection needs read-only access; activity synchronization and opt-out write-back need write access.

In an Outbound Workflow your team defines the goal and targeting criteria; AI proposes a multitouch cadence and writes personalized email content for each prospect, using your sales materials in the Knowledge Center. No email is sent until the prospect's owner approves it.

Brand Concierge hands a conversation to a person through live chat or meeting booking, keeping the context the visitor already provided. Both route through Marketo Qualifier, where your representatives connect their calendars, set their availability and take chats; the first representative to accept takes it.

Marketo Qualifier reports on outbound activity and results across your team, and by Outbound Workflow campaign on active prospects, open rate, click rate, reply rate and meetings booked. With activity sync on, your representatives see the outreach activities in the CRM.

services.name: Prospect list imports
services.scope: Prepare and import prospect lists that are not in your client's CRM from CSV files, with the CRM lead ID where there is one and custom columns mapped so generated emails can use them.
services.adobe_quote: Map any custom or additional CSV fields, not only the standard ones.
